description: Mesa County publishes line features for major canals and ditches in the Grand Valley. The layer defines canal name, type and length in miles. The provider distinguishes open channels from underground or piped canals. These mapped conveyance routes can provide network geometry for irrigation-water simulation when combined with capacities, operating rules and water-supply inputs. The catalogue warns that the lines were digitized from aerial photographs, that coverage is not exhaustive and that underground canal locations are less certain. The metadata does not establish hydraulic connectivity, cross-sections, measured flows or a reference date for all features. A similarly titled Armenian canal resource has a different location and source identity. Coverage is limited to the provider-described county infrastructure. Public catalogue and layer metadata are free to access. The catalogue supplies CC BY 4.0 licensing. ArcGIS layer metadata and the landing page returned HTTP 200. Export bodies and feature rows were not downloaded; distribution usability remains unverified. Related records cover other infrastructure layers in this county catalogue.
